bio.text: Wes Kitchens, a Republican, has represented District 9 in the Alabama State Senate since January 2024 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
He was born and raised in Arab, Alabama, and graduated from Arab High School and Auburn University.
He served as director of basketball operations at the University of Denver, later as president of the Arab Chamber of Commerce, and as an agent at Holloway and Hunt Insurance in Arab.
